references.text: Describes the same geographical area with the Jordan Valley, the Arabah plain, and the Salt Sea (Dead Sea) as boundaries, as well as the slopes of Pisgah
Mentions Mount Pisgah where Moses was allowed to see the Promised Land, which is the same mountain referred to as 'the slopes of Pisgah'
Refers to Mount Pisgah and its location by the Arabah plain, the same geographical reference
Describes Israel's southern boundary at the Salt Sea (Dead Sea), which is the same as 'the sea of the Arabah'
Mentions the Arabah plain and the Salt Sea (the sea of the Arabah) as well as the slopes of Pisgah in the description of the conquered land
Refers to the slopes of Pisgah and Beth-jeshimoth in the Arabah plain, the same geographical area as Deuteronomy 4:49
